name: Rindou
source:
A strange woman, who appeared before [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url] when he ran around the mountains on his journey of revenge. Judging from her physique and appearance, she cannot be considered an ordinary person, but she is suspected of being a [url=https://vndb.org/c24963]sanjin[/url]. Nonetheless, she possesses miraculous spiritual power and immortality (possibly due to her long life), and even [url=https://vndb.org/c24963]sanjins[/url] regard her as a mountain princess or goddess.

Her appearance, as well as her senses and personality, are alien to humanity. Rindou continuously speaks and conducts, even to [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]Inami[/url], as if leading one around by the nose.

Although it's unclear how she is related to the [url=https://vndb.org/c48874]protagonist[/url]'s enemies, he hates her strongly and intensely, the same way he hates [url=https://vndb.org/c24963]sanjins[/url]. On the other hand, Rindou finds his emotional outbursts directed at her to be enjoyable.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/raiL/sanzinkou_chara.html]official site[/url]]
